yt_title: Day 5 of 10 — The Farmer | Anaya's Ten Days EP06
short:
Five days left.

She walked all the way out to the fields.
"Please. Just one. I can't pay today, but I will."

The farmer looked at her for a long moment.
And he said no.
cta:
Then, behind her in the rain, somebody called her name 🧡
EP7 tomorrow ✦
